newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek April core inflation stuck at 7.5pct-banker.
newsitem.headline: Greek April core inflation stuck at 7.5pct-banker.

text.p: Greece's core consumer price inflation, which does not include volatile food and energy prices, was unchanged at 7.5 percent year-on-year in April, a senior economist at a foreign bank told Reuters.
Headline inflation eased to 5.9 percent year-on-year in April from 6.0 percent in March according to figures released by the National Statistics Service.
The central bank and the national economy ministry are known to monitor core inflation but do not release figures. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
